beforeSubmitPrompt.command: if echo "${USER_PROMPT:-}" | grep -Eqi '(报错|bug|错误|异常|TypeError|Error:)'; then echo 'Bug-like prompt detected. Consider using @bug-hunter for structured diagnosis.' >&2; fi

stop.command: if git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'src/'; then echo 'Code changed. Consider running /sync to keep docs aligned.' >&2; fi || true
